# FluentUI Icons Search API

This site provides access to Microsoft's FluentUI icon library.

## API Endpoint
GET /api/icons/search

## Parameters
- q: Search query (required) - e.g., "pen", "calendar", "user"
- size: Filter by size (optional) - 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 48
- style: Filter by style (optional) - "regular" or "filled"
- limit: Max results (optional, default: 50, max: 100)
- format: Response format (optional, default: "json")
  - "json" - Full response with all icon metadata
  - "compact" - Minimal JSON with name, style, url only
  - "text" - Plain text, one icon per line (most token-efficient)

## Example
GET /api/icons/search?q=pen&format=text

Response:
Pen → regular: /icons/regular/ic_fluent_pen_24_regular.svg
Pen → filled: /icons/filled/ic_fluent_pen_24_filled.svg

## Usage
Icons can be used via SVG URL directly in HTML/Markdown.
